description:
Step 2: bind the wallet to your organization's Privi Passport so its transactions pass KYA checks. With a
wallet signature the binding is *proven*; without one it is only *declared* (most checkers require proven).
Requires the organization API key.

signature.description: 65-byte hex signature of the challenge message by the wallet
signature.title: Signature

stream_id.description: The agent (stream) that uses this wallet; omit for the whole organization
stream_id.title: Stream Id

name: kya_bind_wallet
title: KYA: bind a wallet
